market: TPEx quote-present policy-A ordinary pool; confirmed subset preserved
price_basis: forward official last-close/reference multiplier only for unique same-day verified quote bridges; not actual shareholder return
unknown_event: no guessed factor; mask feature and forward-label windows crossing uncertainty; retain as-of stock-pool rows
volatility: 20 log daily returns, sample standard deviation
atr: 20-market-day mean true range / current quote proxy close
rule: today close > preceding 60 market-day maximum close AND today volume > 1.5 * preceding 20 market-day mean volume
baseline: same feature-complete as-of pool; top 10 percent by vol20 or ATR with code tie-break
label: next market-day open to signal day +20/+60 close; gross quote proxy only; unknown endpoints or unverified future events stay unknown
